title: Puffin Fishing Charters
specs: King Salmon are the largest salmon in the Pacific Ocean, commonly ranging from 15 to 25 pounds and much larger.
These fast, hard-fighting fish typically arrive in Resurrection Bay in late June through early July, weighing around 8 to 12 pounds.
As the season progresses, their aggressive feeding pushes many silvers to 15 pounds or more by late summer.
Halibut commonly range from 15 to 80 pounds, with larger fish always a possibility in Seward’s productive waters.
